files.accounting.md:
Pick: Ledgerly Standard

Monthly cost: $32

From sources/options.md, prices as of 1 March 2026.

Ledgerly Standard has no limit on invoices, produces GST reports and has two user logins plus a bookkeeper login, so Marguerite gets her own login.

Tally Lite stops at 20 invoices a month, which is half of what is sent. Brookfield Books adds payroll, which is not needed yet, at about twice the price.

files.thoughts.md:
Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
